issues.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. In a crash, the driver's airbag inflator could burst and throw metal pieces toward the driver.
issues.why: Driver airbag inflators in these cars can let in moisture over time or were built with a defect, so they can rupture when the airbag deploys. Recalls 16V-061 and 19V-182 cover 2013-2016 ILX and 2013-2014 ILX Hybrid.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away and have an Acura dealer replace the inflator for free. This is a serious safety recall.

issues.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, won't start, or stalls while driving. The check engine light may come on first.
issues.why: The plastic impeller inside the in-tank fuel pump can swell until the pump seizes. Honda's recalls 21V-215 and 23V-858 cover many ILX models from this period.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. A dealer replaces the fuel pump module for free. If the car stalls, get it to the side of the road safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Brake pedal may go soft from a master cylinder leak (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal sometimes feels soft, travels further than normal, or sinks toward the floor, and the car takes longer to stop.
issues.why: Contaminated brake fluid can swell a seal inside the brake master cylinder so fluid leaks internally. Recall 25V-859 covers 2016-2020 ILX, and dealers had reports of soft pedals on 2019-2020 cars.
issues.next: If the pedal feels soft or sinks, drive as little as possible and have it checked right away. Check your VIN for the recall; the dealer replaces the master cylinder for free.

issues.t: Front axle can pull apart from the shaft (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk followed by a sudden loss of drive power: the engine revs but the car doesn't move. The car could also roll while in Park.
issues.why: Extra grease at the factory can stop a retaining ring from locking the axle into the half shaft, so it can work loose. Recall 19V-424 covers 2016-2019 ILX.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the free inspection. Always set the parking brake when parked until the work is done.

issues.t: Driveshaft can break from rust (recall)
issues.sym: A loud clunk and sudden loss of drive power. If the shaft breaks while parked, the car could roll unless the parking brake is set.
issues.why: The protective coating on the drive shafts may not have been applied properly, so road salt can corrode and weaken them. Recall 20V-770 covers 2013-2015 ILX and 2013 ILX Hybrid sold in salt-belt states.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The dealer inspects both shafts and replaces them for free if needed. Use the parking brake every time you park.

issues.t: Fuel gauge shows more gas than is in the tank (recall)
issues.sym: The fuel gauge reads higher than the real level, or gets stuck, so the car can run out of gas while the gauge still shows fuel.
issues.why: A deformed fuel tank can make the fuel level float stick. Recall 19V-052 covers 2014-2019 ILX.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer inspects and replaces the tank for free. Until then, reset the trip meter at each fill-up and refuel by mileage.

issues.t: Headlights can overheat and melt (recall)
issues.sym: Dim headlights, a burning plastic smell, or smoke or melting around the headlight assembly.
issues.why: On cars built in certain date ranges, heat around the headlight bulb is not carried away well enough, especially when the car is standing still. Recall 14V-323 covers some 2013-2014 ILX and ILX Hybrid.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer replaces the headlights for free.

issues.t: Front door may not latch (recall)
issues.sym: A front door doesn't stay shut or can open while driving, often after using the inside handle while the door was locked.
issues.why: Using the inside handle with the lock engaged can stretch the latch cable so the latch doesn't catch. Recall 12V-338 replaced the front door latches.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If a door won't latch firmly, don't drive with passengers until it's fixed.

issues.t: Bump or hard downshift when coming to a stop
issues.sym: A clunk or jolt as the car slows to a stop, usually as the transmission shifts from second to first. It comes and goes. Some owners also describe jerky or slipping shifts.
issues.why: The 8-speed dual-clutch transmission can make harsh low-speed downshifts. Acura issued Service Bulletin B17003 for it.
issues.next: Ask an Acura dealer to check for Service Bulletin B17003 and any transmission software updates. Have the fluid checked if it slips or the problem gets worse.

issues.t: Knock or rattle for a few seconds on cold start
issues.sym: A short knocking, clicking or rattling sound from the engine right after a cold start, which then goes away.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B19-012 covers this cold-start noise. On this engine it usually comes from the variable valve timing (VTC) actuator on the intake camshaft.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the noise against Service Bulletin B19-012. Keep the oil at the right level and changed on time. The fix is usually a new VTC actuator.

issues.t: Water pump bearing can seize and shred the drive belt
issues.sym: A squeal or grinding from the front of the engine, then a slapping noise when the drive belt breaks. Charging and power steering warnings may come on, and the engine can overheat.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B17-030 says some water pumps had a bearing that was out of specification and could seize.
issues.next: If the belt breaks or the temperature climbs, pull over and shut the engine off. Have the water pump and drive belt replaced and ask the dealer about Service Bulletin B17-030.

issues.t: Oil leak from the oil pressure sensor
issues.sym: Drops of oil under the engine or an oily film around the oil pressure sensor. A burning oil smell is possible if it drips on hot parts.
issues.why: RepairPal reports that the oil pressure sensor on 2016-2017 ILX can start to leak around its seal in normal use.
issues.next: Check the oil level often until it's fixed. Replacing the sensor is a quick and cheap repair.

issues.t: Steering wheel rattles or creaks when turning
issues.sym: A rattle, creak or rubbing sound from the steering wheel or driver's airbag area when you turn the wheel or drive over bumps.
issues.why: Acura issued Service Bulletins B16-025 and B20-038 for noises from the driver's airbag area and steering wheel, and dealer messages covered steering wheel noise on 2017-2020 ILX.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check the steering wheel against these bulletins. It's a comfort issue, but have it looked at if the airbag light also comes on.

issues.t: Front suspension knock or clunk over bumps
issues.sym: A knock, clunk, rattle or creak from the front of the car over bumps or rough roads.
issues.why: Acura sent dealers many messages in 2021-2022 about front suspension noise on 2017-2022 ILX. Common sources are stabilizer bar links, bushings, and strut mounts.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Worn links and bushings are not costly to replace, but get it checked so a worn steering or suspension part isn't missed.

issues.t: Rear suspension clunk over bumps
issues.sym: A clunk or thump from the back of the car over bumps. Owners describe it as noisy on bumps.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B18-010 says the rear damper rubber can send too much noise into the cabin.
issues.next: Ask a dealer about Service Bulletin B18-010. Have the shocks and mounts checked if the noise gets louder.

issues.t: Touchscreen freezes or presses itself
issues.sym: The lower touchscreen stops responding, freezes, or acts as if it's being pressed when nobody touches it.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B18070B says debris can get into the gap between the touch screen and its frame.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check the screen against Service Bulletin B18070B before agreeing to replace the whole unit.

issues.t: Paint peeling on blue cars and around the windows
issues.sym: Paint flakes or peels, often on the roof pillars and around the windshield and rear glass.
issues.why: Acura extended the paint warranty (B20-047) for 2016-2018 ILX in Catalina Blue Pearl or Bright Kinetic Blue Pearl, and dealers also got reports of peeling on the pillars.
issues.next: Ask an Acura dealer whether your car's paint color and VIN are still covered by the extended warranty. Take photos to document it.

issues.t: Moisture or fog inside the headlights
issues.sym: Condensation, fog or water droplets inside one or both headlights, sometimes dimming the light.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B23-012 says the headlight can touch a body panel, which breaks the seal between the lens and housing and lets moisture in.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to inspect the headlights against Service Bulletin B23-012. Water left inside can ruin bulbs and reflectors.

issues.t: Tire pressure light on from a faulty sensor
issues.sym: The tire pressure (TPMS) warning light stays on or flashes even when all tires are properly inflated.
issues.why: Acura dealer messages in 2021-2022 describe the TPMS light coming on because of a faulty tire pressure sensor.
issues.next: First check all four tire pressures with a gauge. If they're correct and the light stays on, have the sensors scanned; usually one sensor needs to be replaced.

issues.t: Check engine light with code U0155 (lost gauge communication)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on and a scan shows code U0155, meaning the engine computer lost contact with the gauge cluster.
issues.why: Acura issued Service Bulletin B21-011 for this communication fault.
issues.next: Have a dealer read the codes and follow Service Bulletin B21-011.

issues.t: Airbag light on from an airbag control unit fault
issues.sym: The SRS airbag warning light stays on.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B21100A lists several possible causes for code U3000-49, which points to an internal fault in the airbag control unit.
issues.next: Get it checked soon. Airbags may not work correctly while the light is on.

issues.t: No-start from a weak 12-volt battery
issues.sym: The car won't start or only clicks, sometimes with several warning lights on the dash.
issues.why: Acura issued bulletins in 2013 and investigated more reports in 2014 about no-starts that needed a new 12-volt battery. On the ILX Hybrid, a drained 12-volt battery can stop the car starting even when the hybrid battery is charged.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested. Replace a weak battery, and check for things that drain it if it keeps happening.

issues.t: Intermittent no-start from a failing starter
issues.sym: Sometimes the engine won't crank when you press start, or it just clicks, then starts fine the next time.
issues.why: RepairPal reports ILX owners with intermittent starting problems that point to a failing starter.
issues.next: Have the battery and cables tested first. If they're good, a shop can test the starter and replace it.

issues.t: Chirping from the engine mount on rough roads
issues.sym: A chirping or squeaking from the engine bay over rough roads, mostly in hot weather.
issues.why: An Acura service bulletin says parts inside the side engine mount can rub and chirp.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the noise and replace the side engine mount if needed.

issues.t: Check engine light for an evaporative leak (fuel cap)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with codes P0455 or P0456 (evaporative emissions leak).
issues.why: Acura bulletins say a loose or sticking fuel cap is a common cause on these cars.
issues.next: Make sure the gas cap clicks tight. If the light comes back, replace the cap and have the evaporative system tested.

issues.t: Check engine light with code P0101 (airflow sensor)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P0101, often with no change in how the car drives.
issues.why: Acura bulletin SB-14-015 says the engine computer can misread the mass airflow sensor during steady throttle changes.
issues.next: Ask a dealer for the engine computer software update from the bulletin before buying a new airflow sensor.

issues.t: False starter relay code with a partly pressed clutch
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P16F7 (starter cut relay) on cars with the manual transmission.
issues.why: Acura Service Bulletin B15-043 says holding the clutch partly down can make the computer wrongly think the starter relay is stuck.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the code and follow Service Bulletin B15-043. Press the clutch fully when starting.

issues.t: Hybrid inverter failure
issues.sym: Hybrid system warnings come on, the electric assist stops working, and the car may lose power or not start.
issues.why: Acura says the motor power inverter can fail over time because of a bad solder joint, and extended the warranty on certain 2013 ILX Hybrids (B20-021).
issues.next: Ask an Acura dealer with your VIN whether the inverter warranty extension still applies before paying for repairs.

issues.t: Hybrid (IMA) battery loses capacity or fails
issues.sym: The IMA or check engine light comes on, the hybrid battery gauge swings or stays low, electric assist fades, and fuel economy drops.
issues.why: Like other Honda IMA hybrids, the battery modules wear out with age. Acura only supplies remanufactured IMA battery modules for repairs (bulletin B12-012).
issues.next: Have the hybrid system scanned. A remanufactured or rebuilt battery is the usual fix; compare dealer and hybrid specialist quotes.
